steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (My equipment's all good. My sword... it's the one Margaret used when she was training. It should still be usable, right?)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Okay, I'm all set. Time to go...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh... Uncle Młynar.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Let me guess. Off to blemish our family's reputation?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Am not—!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I've already heard about the Major from my colleagues.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: You don't deserve to stand in an arena for knights. What's more, the Major doesn't deserve the Nearls.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Was it Zofia who gave you the idea?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No! I signed up myself!

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: I figured as much. She may just be a lady-in-waiting to our family, but she nonetheless made a name for herself in that capitalist charade... She is a knight, for all that's worth.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: But what does that make you?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I just want to defend our...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Even if we're stripped of our nobility, our ideals remain unchanged. We have nothing to defend.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Even so...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Above all, there is nothing we need you to defend.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Don't be like your sister. Just because she's still young and full of beans, she lost all self-control—

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: —Yes, Chief?

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Good evening. Yes, that's right, it's me...

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Worry not. If you have any questions about what we discussed in our last meeting, please do not hesitate... I beg your pardon? No, please. Please reconsider... Yes...
Młynar glares at Maria and walks upstairs indifferently.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: My apologies. I take full responsibility. I will have the corrected documents sent to you right away... Tomorrow, yes, I will have it ready for you tomorrow... I am very sorry.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: Please. Please reconsider. Definitely. I won't ever make such a mistake again.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: —Maria, I'll deal with you another time. I hope you'll know your place.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uncle Młynar...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Getting intimidated won't do me any good here... If I don't hurry, I'll be late for practice.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nnngg—!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Watch your footing. And keep your rhythm.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hnn—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's been ten minutes, and you haven't returned my attacks once.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Uhh... You said you'd take me on with just one hand, but that's a one-handed sword!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I wouldn't be using one hand If I really fought you. Or would you rather try a Leithanian style?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I knew knights from other countries had different fighting styles... Are you telling me you can fight like them too? You're actually picking on me, aren't you!?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Only a copycat. I lost that fight not for a lack of preparation, you know.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Auntie...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Well, it's all in the past. It's not something I lose sleep over.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'm more worried about you. Look how unprepared you are... you're just sending yourself to a quick death, wanting to fight in the Major.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hnng...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Alright, let's get back to it.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: O-Okay, but give me just another minute... My legs are still trembling...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If you can't even handle this much, you'd better give up now.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nnngg—! Okay, let's go!
The next day.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haa.... Haaah... H-How's that?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What do you mean, 'How's that?' You're barely standing upright.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Aside from sleeping and eating... we've basically... been working out the whole time... Don't you get tired at all, Zofia...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...You know about the team melees?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Those are the matches draw the crowds to the Kazimierz Major. Each knightclub sends a single representative—Well, in your case, you're joining the fray as an individual.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You have somewhere around a couple dozen people all in a huge, man-made arena. You rack up points by striking your opponents' armor, and those are added to your overall score.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Of course... if you're defeated or incapacitated before the time limit, you're immediately eliminated, and you score zero points.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...I-I know at least that much...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Uh huh. Then, tell me, do you know how long a single melee lasts?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: ...A few hours?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The longest melee match ever lasted the entire day and well into the night, after the audience kept cheering and the corporations kept tacking on overtime.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The knights in that match were like a bunch of Gloompincers locked in a cage together. They had to rally themselves over and over to keep fighting each other.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Umm...?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: One by one, the contestants fell either from exhaustion or injury, and no one got anything to show for it. On the other hand, the three who lasted till the very end raked in more than enough points to immediately advance to the main competitions.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-I see... so the match lasted a whole day, and only three made it through...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Once we got the first division sponsor pushing that kind of ruleset, the copycats started to show up left and right across all divisions like Originium Slugs.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's certainly not a pretty sight, but what's worse is that the audience likes it. So nothing else matters.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Which means you'll have to be ready to fight an entire day!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —An entire day?!
A week later.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's call it here. You're getting better at this.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahh—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't just lie down right after you're done working out. Get up and walk around a little. Maybe think about what to have for dinner tonight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: O-Okay. Hmm! My legs are so sore...!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Well, of course. Your pacing is terrible.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: We can probably forget about winning the sprint race... All the top knightclubs have members who specialize in that, and if they show up, we've got no hope there.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That said, mobility is still very important in artificial terrain.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Naturally, how well you do in the races has to do with how well-equipped you are. We've got to work on your stamina, but the real bottleneck there is our budget...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Are you even listening?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ahh—! I got it!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I just remembered Marcin gave me two meal coupons for fixing the jukebox the other day! Why don't we have dinner there tonight?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What should I even do with you...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: D-Don't be mad! I just wanted to do something for you to show my gratitude!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'm not mad. So, when are we leaving?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: We don't eat out together often... Is it okay if I take a shower and get a change of clothes first?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Okay... but we'll get right back to training after dinner. We don't have time for you to slack off.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (Maria is clearly making progress. And here I thought she decided to do this on a whim...)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (She's serious about this... and she's more serious than she looks. I was thinking she wouldn't be ready with so little training... I was even going to talk her out of it.)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (She's working so hard to get there, but she's just as cheerful as always... I wonder who she learned that from.)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (Is this her fighting spirit...?)
Zofia lifts her head up. In the distance, far away from the garden overgrown with weeds, the lights of the towering skyscrapers glitter brilliantly in the city's skyline.
She quietly places her oft-unused hand on her sword's hilt, like she's deceiving herself.
Just as she expected, before she's even managed to unsheathe her sword, she feels an intense muscle pain shoot up her arm from her waist. She quickly lets go before she loses consciousness.
Three weeks later.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: When was the last time those two brats showed their faces here? Could've paid the bar a visit on their time off. What are they being so shy for?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Are kids finally coming around to the idea of shutting yourself inside and training all day?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...When did anyone ever do that?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I did, back when I was a kid.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Knights train as they roam the world. Who ever heard of shutting yourself indoors just to train?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...*Sigh*. Filthy rich knights wouldn't know how hard life is for us common folk, with all the Catastrophe Messengers money can buy and the means to travel anywhere... You can't imagine how much hard work went into that sword of yours...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What are you mumbling on about now? If you're trying to pick a fight, then do it. I'm not afraid of you!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You can't possibly think I'm talking about you?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Quiet down!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...You hear that...? They're working on her swordfighting.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I'm not deaf! Yeah, not bad. You know those shoddy practice swords on the market? Those are way too light to do any actual training with. Those trash manufacturers are always cutting corners.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Not these ones, though. They even sound beautiful. You can tell they're very fine blades... but how come I think I've heard this sword before?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Because you're old.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Why do I even bother talking to you? Get a move on!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...You aren't lost, are you? Got dementia or something?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What's the hurry?! Zofia's garden is huge—We should've asked the servant at the gate for a motorcycle.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You aren't getting anywhere with a motorcycle here. There's more weeds than an overgrown forest.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hey, watch your step.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Whew—Almost fell... What's this? An engine cover? In a garden?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Watch your step! Control your breath!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Hm... still the basics.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: They've been training for a month, and they're still working on the basics. Looks like we're going to miss out on a lot of points.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Maybe you're the one with dementia here, Kowal.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: You wanna say that again?!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Yes, they've been working on the basics for a month, but Maria's from the Nearl family.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Do you think she didn't practice these 'basics' back when Ol' Pegasus and Margaret were around?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Well... now that you mention it.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Area of expertise? Their standings? Why does any of that matter?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: A real Kazimierz knight should always be working on his technique.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haah... haah...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't stop. Good momentum. Let's keep going!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But... I'm really...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Right, right, I hear you. Let's make sure you stay in bed for the next three days, then—!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: (Whistle)

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Whew, that one thrust was something.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: It's a backhand thrust, it's fast, and above all, it hits where it matters, the vitals. So her training's paying off?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: ...How long have you been there?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Just got here.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Hohoh, watching her reminds me of the good old times when Margaret was still around.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Did you just...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh? Oh? I did that out of habit... Um... Did I do something?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Um... Where's your sword?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: T-That hit just now flung it away...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't get cocky! I'm just upset you managed to strike my opening!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh? So you do leave openings, Auntie Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Tsk...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Fine, a promise is a promise. You can fight in the Major.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: For real?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But I'll be there coaching you the whole time. You know nothing about the basics of the competitions, and there's still lots for you to learn... the scheduling, the scoring, how to analyze all the intel—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Don't lie down! Get up! We still have lots of preparation to do!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Come on... Just let me... take a short break...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't fall asleep on me!
